$schemaNote: DESIGN / CONFIG EXAMPLE ONLY. The current runtime (src/client-profile.js, src/oauth.js) does NOT read this file. Encoding this JSON does not change any behavior. See docs/OPEN-SOURCE/CLIENT-PROFILES.md.

resultEncoding.note: Gemini cannot consume structuredContent. Keep content:[{type:'text',text:JSON.stringify(result)}] and strip structuredContent entirely. Matches CLIENT_PROFILES[gemini] in src/client-profile.js.

annotationsDefault.note: Defaults only for tools with no annotations at all; sanitizeTool already sets explicit hints. Today src/client-profile.js keeps annotations identical across profiles - these values are the design target, not a new behavior.

oauth.flow: OAuth 2.1 DCR + PKCE S256 (or pre-registered client id/secret in advanced settings)

callbackAllowlist.note: Exact shape enforced by isAllowedRedirectUri() in src/oauth.js: https only, no userinfo, host in set, pathname starts with /r/ or /a/.

constraints: Non-rotating refresh tokens (returned unchanged on refresh).
AS metadata must include registration_endpoint even for pre-registered clients.
Enterprise connector path uses a different fixed redirect (https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect) and is OUT OF SCOPE of this profile.

toolSurface.naming: server__tool (double underscore; Gemini splits on first underscore)
toolSurface.schema: sanitizeTool before registration; flat schemas; stable order; no mid-session tools/list_changed

knownLimitations: Account-gated: personal Google account, 18+, US only, English UI, Activity on; work/school accounts unsupported.
No structuredContent; schema snapshot taken at registration - changing tools requires a new version path (/v1, /v2).
GET on the Streamable HTTP stream may return 405 - expected.
unverified: No second real Gemini account/region has been tested; baseline is the single existing deployment.
